items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: One time. He hired Buddy with him. Buddy Pete. Buddy played with him too.

ctx.x: Did you know what kind he had?
No, I didn't know what the mouthpiece he had. I never used it. And what else I took and done? That time, like, Buddy, I used to let you get Buddy and Kid Rene get together.

You would, didn't you see any of those? I heard Kid Rene. I never heard Buddy Petito. Buddy was tough, man. I never got together. Oh. Now, Buddy, you ever heard Chris Kelly? Oh, never heard him. I've heard of him a lot.
